name: Group Content Moderation
description: Enable Content Moderation workflow transitions to be used by group members
project_description:
The Group Content Moderation module extends the Group module to support the Content Moderation functionality.

 The code is developed based on issue #2906085 .

 Note for Group 1 

 This patch in the Group module adds support for a 'view own unpublished entity' permission. This is useful for use cases where you'd like normal members to also use content moderation steps (e.g. view their content in Moderated Content overview).
